purpose: Source-shaped differential coverage for the archived Pegasus Weather test file.

candidate.runtime: host Node (the comparator records the exact version)

observableContract: WeatherParse output and null/undefined branch shapes
asynchronous WeatherParse resolution and rejection propagation (a rejected promise fails the side receipt)
ordered Weather MIM selection and day/evening selection
fixed-offset ISO time selection at the source test's noon and 6PM boundaries
weather high/low view JSON, assets, units, thresholds, and x offsets
qualifications: This is a controlled source versus local candidate differential; it does not claim live DarkSky/provider availability, freshness, deployment, or Moth behavior.
The fixture uses the source test's deterministic synthetic weather data and a fixed offset ISO clock.
The source runner executes compiled modules produced from the pinned source revision; the source test hash and compiled record are checked before rows run.
